games.title: Adventure Universe
games.description: Explore a colourful fantasy galaxy, collect stardust and travel between magical learning worlds.

games.title: Rainbow Runway
games.description: Dash across floating rainbow bridges, collect stardust, jump over friendly cloud bumps and explore a magical sky world.

games.title: ABC Letter Adventure
games.description: A 500-question alphabet challenge covering letter recognition, sounds, sequencing and early word puzzles.
games.coverageNote: The question bank is strongest for early learners. A smaller set of questions overlaps with age 8; broader 8–10 content and an 11–12 collection are still being developed.

games.title: Tobi's Rainbow Run
games.description: A colourful collect-the-stars adventure with gentle obstacles.

games.title: Magical Memory Match
games.description: Turn over picture cards, find matching pairs and build memory skills with a challenge that grows from 3 to 10 pairs.

games.title: Pet Planet
games.description: Adopt a magical little friend. Feed, give fresh water, brush and play while learning kindness and responsibility.

games.title: Ocean of Wonders
games.description: Swim through a glowing underwater reef, collect shining pearls and dodge playful jellyfish on a magical sea adventure.
